proposed_harness.name: loop_engineering_stage_state_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/loop_engineering/stage_state.schema.json requiring schema_version v1, stage_id pattern ^L[0-9]{2}_[A-Z0-9_]+$, status enum NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS|PASS|BLOCKED, phase enum from 06_STATE_AND_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md, timestamps, branch, base_head, current_head, constraints, blockers, and files_touched.

proposed_harness.name: loop_engineering_subagent_response_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/loop_engineering/subagent_response.schema.json matching codex/loop_engineering/02_AGENT_PROTOCOL.md, including role enum for all seven required agents, verdict enum APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUESTED|BLOCKED, finding severity enum low|medium|high, proposed_harness type enum unit|integration|cli|schema|artifact|real_valkey|ci, and required context_files_read entries.

proposed_harness.name: loop_engineering_command_log_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/loop_engineering/command_log_entry.schema.json for commands.jsonl lines requiring started_at, finished_at, cwd, command as a non-empty string array, integer exit_code, stdout_tail, stderr_tail, and status enum PASS|FAIL|SKIPPED_WITH_REASON; allow optional environment metadata without permitting command as a shell string.

proposed_harness.name: loop_engineering_stage_result_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/loop_engineering/stage_result.schema.json requiring the full 06_STATE_AND_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md shape, including previous_harness_passed, current_harness_passed, all seven subagent_verdicts, commands_log, artifacts, metrics_added, visualizations_added, real_valkey_gates, fake_gates, known_missing_metrics, and risks_remaining.

proposed_harness.name: loop_engineering_global_state_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/loop_engineering/global_loop_state.schema.json requiring project valkey-scale-lab, branch, last_updated_at, current_stage, stages with status enum PASS|IN_PROGRESS|BLOCKED|NOT_STARTED, pushed boolean, result_path, blockers, and latest_report_index.

proposed_harness.name: loop_engineering_validator_cli
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add scripts/loop_engineering_validate.py with a dependency-free CLI that reuses scripts/schema_validator.py, validates all discovered stage_state.json, subagents/*.json, commands.jsonl, stage_result.json, optional global_loop_state.json, and exits non-zero with aggregated findings on any schema or cross-file invariant failure.

proposed_harness.name: command_log_cross_field_validation
proposed_harness.acceptance: The validator must reject empty commands.jsonl, invalid JSON lines, command fields that are strings instead of arrays, PASS entries with non-zero exit_code, FAIL entries with exit_code 0 unless an explicit skipped reason is used, and missing stdout_tail or stderr_tail fields.

proposed_harness.name: subagent_artifact_validation
proposed_harness.acceptance: The validator must reject subagent files whose filename role does not match agent_role, whose stage_id does not match the parent stage directory, whose verdict is outside the protocol enum, or whose required context_files_read and acceptance_criteria are empty for design/review roles.

proposed_harness.name: stage_result_artifact_validation
proposed_harness.acceptance: The validator must reject PASS stage_result.json if previous_harness_passed or current_harness_passed is false, pushed is false, commit_sha is empty, commands_log does not exist, any required subagent verdict is missing or not APPROVED, or a referenced artifact path is missing.

proposed_harness.name: anti_regression_entrypoint

acceptance_criteria: Previous harness baseline remains PASS and is not weakened.
schemas/loop_engineering contains committed schemas for stage_state, subagent_response, command_log_entry, stage_result, and global_loop_state.

scripts/loop_engineering_validate.py --root artifacts/loop_engineering validates the current loop root and returns non-zero with clear findings on malformed JSON, schema violations, or cross-file invariant failures.
Command-log validation rejects empty JSONL, invalid JSONL, command strings, status/exit_code mismatches, and missing output tails.
Subagent validation rejects missing required fields, invalid roles, filename/agent_role mismatch, parent stage/stage_id mismatch, and invalid verdicts.
Stage-result validation rejects PASS without previous/current harness PASS, pushed true, non-empty commit_sha, existing commands_log, and APPROVED verdicts for all required subagents.
An anti-regression mode is runnable and blocks obvious harness weakening in protected paths without modifying the worktree.
At least one existing workflow runs scripts/loop_engineering_validate.py and the loop-engineering pytest pack while keeping P14 and real Valkey gates out of automatic L00 CI.
No real Valkey gate is added for L00; L00 is a fake/artifact/schema/CI harness bootstrap stage only.
risks: If the schemas only mirror templates loosely, malformed subagent or command artifacts could still pass and undermine later stage auditability.
If the validator treats missing global_loop_state.json as fatal during L00 bootstrap, it will block the first stage before global state legitimately exists.
If anti-regression scanning is too broad or content-naive, it may block harmless additions; if too narrow, it may miss required-to-optional or real-to-fake downgrades.
If CI workflow assertions are added without updating workflows, the new CI pack should fail as expected until the workflow is strengthened.
If command-log validation requires environment-specific absolute paths, it may become brittle across Mac, Linux, and CI.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not mark stage_result.json PASS by hand before validator, tests, review, validation, anti-regression, commit, and push requirements are satisfied.
Do not weaken codex/phase_manifest.json, codex/gate_lock.json, existing scripts, existing schemas, templates, docs/codex, or existing workflows to make L00 pass.
Do not make commands.jsonl accept shell-string commands; command arrays are required for reproducible audit.
Do not allow subagent verdicts outside APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED.
Do not count P14 dry-run artifacts or planner outputs as real Valkey evidence.
Do not add automatic real Valkey or 1000-node gates to L00 CI.
Do not rely on markdown reports as the source of truth for L00 validation.
Do not hide validation failures by recording SKIPPED_WITH_REASON without a concrete reason field.
